scenes.say: For you to win, someone has to lose? Only in one specific kind of game.
A zero-sum game: what you gain is exactly what they lose. No new value is created.
Matching pennies: match, you win one. Don't match, you lose one.
scenes.note: Illustrative payoffs; code solves the mixed equilibrium

scenes.say: No fixed choice is safe. The best strategy: pure randomness, {mix_row} each way.
But most of life isn't zero-sum. Trade, cooperation, learning: they all create new value.
Before treating someone as an opponent, ask if you could both come out ahead.

takeaway: Before treating someone as an opponent, ask if you could both come out ahead.
